title: zPansitoA's Small Totem & Totem Pop
description: A minecraft texture pack that changes the totems to a nicer texture!
body:
# **_zPansitoA's_ Small Totem & Pop**
**_For more updates join my discord or RageIP's server (unstable smp stuff) the link is below_**
- https://discord.gg/tBeezfPBK
- https://discord.gg/MRSU5YRzdQ

zPansitoA's Small Totem & Pop is a simple resource pack that improves the appearance of the Totem of Undying while making it less distracting.

## **Features**
- Smaller Totem of Undying when held in your hand.
- Smaller activation animation when the totem saves you from death.
- New animated texture with a cleaner and smoother design.
- Less screen obstruction while keeping the vanilla style.

This pack is perfect for PvP, Crystal PvP, Survival, or anyone who prefers a cleaner look without changing Minecraft's gameplay.

Compatible with modern Minecraft versions and easy to use with any resource pack setup.
